notes: לוֹ is fused as the genitive his because the ASV spends no separate word on the preposition's relation (rule 49's closing), and the written הָיָה keeps the copula.
תְּרוּמָה → heave offering is headed on the class noun offering, consistently with מִנְחָה → meal offering elsewhere in the chapter; the reverse head on heave is named in that unit's note.
